text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing, as Smart 
Falcon and I walked through the shopping 
district—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ah...! This fried food shop brings back 
memories~

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see. Before Falco held her very 
first street live...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I ate the ham cutlet here all by myself as 
a good luck charm, saying to myself, "I'll 
overcome my nerves!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's one of the Umadol memories that leads 
up to the Falco of today☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"...Oh, I know! Since we're here, let's 
grab some ham cutlets!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
This is a nostalgic taste for Falco... I'd 
love for Trainer to try it too♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I bought two ham cutlets from the fried 
food shop and ate them together with Smart 
Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Crunch, crunch...)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Mm, it's delicious. That crunch makes it 
even better...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Pfft...! Ahaha! Trainer, you're stuffing 
your face way too much!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Still, you seem to like it that much, so 
Falco is super happy☆"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for the meal!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's kind of strange. Maybe Falco's just 
imagining things, though...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I feel like it tasted even better than the 
last time I had it!
choice_data_list: Maybe it's because we ate it together?
The shop must be trying hard too.

The shop must be working hard as well, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I feel like it tasted even better than the 
last time I had it!
choice_data_list: Maybe it's because we ate it together?
The shop must be trying hard too.

The shop must be working hard as well, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I see! Food always tastes better when you 
eat together with someone, huh.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Then Falco thinks it's because you're not 
just 'anyone,' you're 'Trainer-san'♪

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. If you don't get it, you can just 
leave it as it is!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
In return, just one thing... Will you 
grant Falco a wish?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I want you to remember eating ham cutlets 
with Falco today forever and ever.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"It might seem like a casual little thing, 
but if we keep building up memories like 
this—"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It becomes a massive driving force to keep 
working hard toward your dreams!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Of cooourse☆ Because...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"Falco's doing that too to become a cute 
top Umadol♪"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward... along the sunset-tinted way 
home, I walked slowly together with her.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I see! So that's the result of the fry 
shop's professional dedication, huh.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
The taste of those memories has changed. 
So that Falco can change from who she was 
back then too—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
"To become a cute top Umadol, I've gotta 
try harder and harder...!"

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ehehe. Thanks, Trainer☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
—All riiight! Motivation's surging up big 
time~!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I was planning to take today off, but I'm 
gonna hurry home and do some 
self-training!
choice_data_list: I'll think about the menu on the way back.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Yeah...! I'm counting on you.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Something we can whip through quickly 
before dorm curfew, but that still feels 
hearty and substantial...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I'd love something like a ham cutlet! Well 
then, let's get going, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward... along the sunset-tinted way 
home, I ran as she urged me on.
